kills: writing judge marks drop and count a mark whose quote is not in the piece

mutations.name: the trusted flag ignores the canary
kills: writing judge trust is untrusted when the canary is unmarked, which leaves both gated rows unmeasured and failing

mutations.name: the one-term allowance is removed
kills: writing:words-per-term always allows one term, even in a text shorter than the floor

mutations.name: a failed call maps to a pass
